title: Elimination
description: Given only the cut-off scores and minimal scores of the top 100 participants in two elimination contests, find the minimal possible total score of the 100th place after summing both contest scores.
input_format: Four space-separated integers: a, b, c, d.
output_format: Print a single integer — the minimal possible total score of the 100th participant.
expected_approach: Compute max(a + b, c + d); the 100th score is the larger of these two sums.
